passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: This is my body, and I have a head.
phrases.ko: 이것은 나의 몸이고, 나에게는 머리가 있어요.

phrases.en: I shut one eye, and I hear with my ear.
phrases.ko: 나는 한쪽 눈을 감고, 귀로 들어요.

phrases.en: I open my mouth when I sing.
I wave my hand, and I hop on one foot.
phrases.ko: 나는 손을 흔들고, 한 발로 뛰어요.

phrases.en: I move my body every day.
I wash my hands before I eat.
My two eyes help me read.
phrases.ko: 나의 두 눈은 내가 책을 읽도록 도와줘요.

phrases.en: I take care of my body because I want to be strong.
A healthy girl can run and play.
phrases.ko: 건강한 여자아이는 달리고 놀 수 있어요.

phrases.en: I move, I rest, and I grow.

full_passage_spoken: This is my body, and I have a head. I shut one eye, and I hear with my ear. I open my mouth when I sing. I wave my hand, and I hop on one foot. I move my body every day. A healthy body is strong. I wash my hands before I eat. My two eyes help me read. I take care of my body because I want to be strong. A healthy girl can run and play. I move, I rest, and I grow.
